verdict: Leads are flowing steadily; pipeline conversion is the number to watch.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 124 leads at $11.84 per lead — cost per lead held essentially flat this week, down just 4%. Lead volume dipped this week because ad spend was pulled back, not because the ads stopped working; efficiency remains solid. The more important question right now is how many of those leads are booking appointments, and that picture is currently incomplete because two tracking setups — phone-match attribution and contact sync — are overdue and being resolved now. Once those are in place, the full lead-to-patient count will be readable ahead of the end-of-August scorecard.
